segments.text: Stop chasing perfection. Just start speaking. You know why your English is not improving? Because you are waiting for perfection.
So listen, you don't need to speak perfect English. You just need to have courage to speak.
I don't understand what is so inspiring about her.
Let's say you want to look like your favorite celebrity. Therefore, you should procrastinate for six months overthinking whether keto, intermittent fasting, or push-pull legs is the perfect plan.
But why start now when you can wait for next Monday while sitting-
so that you can successfully protect a physique you are unhappy with anyway.

Just ignore this lady and whatever you do, do not share this video with that one friend who has been starting their fitness journey next Monday since 2020. And follow me to learn how to skip the gym and stay stuck forever.
